# BrewMath

> BrewMath is an offline homebrew calculator and brew log for iPhone and iPad.

## Canonical pages

- [BrewMath home](https://wbs21.github.io/brewmath/): app overview, calculator list, experiment loop and FAQ.
- [Data sources](https://wbs21.github.io/brewmath/data-sources.html): BJCP editions, brewing formula references and stated limitations.
- [Support](https://wbs21.github.io/brewmath/support.html): purchase restoration, backups, iCloud Drive and troubleshooting.
- [Privacy](https://wbs21.github.io/brewmath/privacy.html): no developer account, analytics or advertising; local data and optional user iCloud Drive backups.

## Product facts

- App name: BrewMath: Brew Calculator
- Platform: iPhone and iPad, iOS 18 or later
- Business model: free calculators and unlimited batches, with one optional one-time Pro purchase
- Account required: no
- Advertising: no
- Developer analytics: no
- Offline calculations: yes
- Data sources: official BJCP style PDFs, public brewing formulas and manufacturer ingredient references
